SB_SYSTEM_ID.description: SecurityBridge SAP system identifier — the SAP SID (3-char alphanumeric like 'PRD' / 'DEV' / 'QAS') or the SecurityBridge-internal numeric system id — that scopes which SAP system's risk record + finding catalogue is pulled. Found in the SecurityBridge console under Systems -> select the SAP system (the value is visible in the URL bar after /systems/) or via GET /api/v1/systems. The executor hard-validates the identifier shape client-side (alphanumeric + ._- up to 64 chars) so a typo or control char can't fan out into '/api/v1/systems/None' calls.

SB_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Optional client-side severity floor for SecurityBridge findings. Accepts info | low | medium | high | critical (plus SecurityBridge synonyms: severe / very_high -> critical, major -> high, moderate / warning -> medium, minor -> low, informational / information -> info) plus numeric-string CVSS-style input bucketed via severity_from_cvss (<4 low, <7 medium, <9 high, >=9 critical). Findings below the floor are dropped from the Faraday output after per-finding severity normalisation (bucketed from the freeform severity string enum + numeric cvss / riskScore 0-10 fallback). Defaults to info (no filtering).

name: securitybridge_sap
title: SecurityBridge (SAP Security)
description: SecurityBridge SAP-security REST importer. Pulls the SAP system-level metadata record (SID + instance + client + product + release + risk score + last scan timestamp) and the open finding catalogue from a SecurityBridge tenant via GET <SB_HOST>/api/v1/systems/{system_id} and GET <SB_HOST>/api/v1/findings?systemId={system_id}. Each monitored SAP system becomes one Faraday host (keyed by the SAP system identifier — SecurityBridge's surface is SAP-system-scoped so the host record is keyed on the SAP SID / internal system id, with host.os carrying the SAP product + release + (optional) risk-score label, e.g. 'SAP NetWeaver 7.50 SP12 (risk=72)', so the SAP stack version is visible alongside the per-finding observations). Each SecurityBridge open finding (one observation tied to one SAP object / report / table / role — auth defects, config drift, transport-bypass attempts, missing SAP Notes, RFC misconfiguration, exposed gateway, role / authorization escalation, etc.) attaches as a Faraday vulnerability with the engine prefix [SAP-SECURITY]. Severity is bucketed from the freeform severity string enum (critical / high / medium / low / info plus SecurityBridge synonyms severe / very_high / major / moderate / warning / minor / informational) with the numeric cvss / riskScore / score 0-10 used as a CVSS-style fallback. Status mapped from status / state / findingStatus / remediation_status (open / new / active / detected / in_progress / reopened -> open, resolved / fixed / remediated / patched / mitigated / completed -> closed, acknowledged / accepted / deferred / waived / will_not_fix / false_positive / suppressed / dismissed / ignored -> risk-accepted). Pagination uses SecurityBridge's canonical limit + offset cursor pattern (PAGE_SIZE=100 per page capped at MAX_PAGES=200) with links.next + total exhaustion detection. Refs include SecurityBridge-Finding / SecurityBridge-Rule / SecurityBridge-Category / SecurityBridge-RiskArea / SecurityBridge-System / SecurityBridge-Client / SecurityBridge-Instance / SecurityBridge-Transport / SecurityBridge-Object pivots plus inline advisory URLs and SAP-Note references (numeric SAP Notes harvested from sap_note / sap_notes / note / notes fields plus 'SAP Note'-anchored inline scans of description / evidence / recommendation). CVE list harvested via a strict CVE-\d{4}-\d+ regex from cve / cveId / cves / details.cve plus title / summary / description / evidence / finding_description token scans. Auth: SecurityBridge issues per-tenant API keys carried as Authorization: Bearer <SB_API_KEY> plus Accept: application/json on every /api/v1/ call. SB_HOST is the SecurityBridge endpoint URL (http(s)://host[:port], trailing slash stripped client-side, control chars rejected). SB_API_KEY is the API key created in the SecurityBridge console under Administration -> API Keys. Tags: [securitybridge, sap-security, securitybridge-sap].
